terms.definitionEn: A syntax extension commonly used to describe UI elements within JavaScript code.
terms.definitionAr: صياغة إضافية بتتستخدم غالبًا لوصف عناصر الواجهة جوه كود JavaScript.

terms.definitionEn: A JavaScript construct that evaluates to a value and can be embedded in JSX using braces.
terms.definitionAr: تعبير JavaScript بينتج قيمة وينفع يتحط في JSX بين أقواس معقوفة.

terms.definitionEn: The JSX prop used to provide a CSS class name to a rendered element.
terms.definitionAr: prop في JSX بنستخدمه عشان نحدد اسم class CSS للعنصر الناتج.

terms.definitionEn: A JSX element with no children that ends with a slash before its closing angle bracket.
terms.definitionAr: عنصر JSX من غير أبناء وبيخلص بشرطة مائلة قبل القوس المقفول.

terms.definitionEn: A React wrapper that groups sibling elements without adding a DOM element.
terms.definitionAr: غلاف من React بيجمع عناصر جنب بعض من غير ما يضيف عنصر للـ DOM.

terms.definitionEn: A property written on a JSX element to configure its behavior or rendered attributes.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية مكتوبة على عنصر JSX عشان تحدد سلوكه أو خصائصه الناتجة.

terms.definitionEn: The single top-level JSX value returned by a component expression.
terms.definitionAr: قيمة JSX واحدة في المستوى الأعلى بترجعها expression بتاعة component.

terms.definitionEn: A JavaScript comment placed inside JSX through a braced expression container.
terms.definitionAr: تعليق JavaScript بيتكتب جوه JSX باستخدام expression بين أقواس معقوفة.

terms.definitionEn: A value describing a React UI node, typically created from JSX or a React API.
terms.definitionAr: قيمة بتوصف عقدة في واجهة React، غالبًا بتتعمل من JSX أو API من React.

terms.definitionEn: A JSX prop whose presence without an explicit value represents true.
terms.definitionAr: prop في JSX وجودها من غير قيمة صريحة بيمثل true.

terms.definitionEn: A syntactic unit that evaluates to a value and can be inserted into JSX content or props.
terms.definitionAr: جزء من صياغة JavaScript بيتحول لقيمة وينفع يتحط في محتوى JSX أو props.

terms.definitionEn: A compiler step that converts JSX syntax into JavaScript calls used to create React elements.
terms.definitionAr: خطوة compiler بتحول صياغة JSX لاستدعاءات JavaScript بتنشئ عناصر React.

questions.question: What does this JSX expression describe?
options: A React element representing a heading with text
A browser DOM node created immediately without rendering
A component function that can be called with a string
A CSS rule that assigns text to every heading
questions.explanation: JSX describes a React element; rendering it is a separate step.
questions.explanationAr: JSX بتوصف React element، وعرضه خطوة منفصلة.

questions.question: What value is inserted into the paragraph?
options: The literal text 'count + 1'
The number 4, rendered as text
A nested paragraph containing count
An empty value because arithmetic is not allowed
questions.explanation: Braces evaluate the JavaScript expression, whose result is 4.
questions.explanationAr: الأقواس بتقيّم تعبير JavaScript ونتيجته 4.

questions.question: What does className configure here?
options: The component's JavaScript function name
The text node's HTML tag
The rendered element's CSS class
The DOM element's React key
questions.explanation: className supplies the class attribute for a JSX-rendered element.
questions.explanationAr: className بتحدد class للعنصر الناتج من JSX.

questions.question: Why is the slash required in this JSX tag?
options: It makes img render as a component instance rather than a built-in element
It supplies the missing alt text automatically for assistive technology
It marks src as a JavaScript expression instead of a string value
JSX requires the element to be explicitly self-closed
questions.explanation: JSX requires tags without children, such as img, to be self-closed.
questions.explanationAr: JSX بتطلب إن العناصر من غير أبناء زي img تتقفل ذاتيًا.

questions.question: What does the short Fragment syntax add to the DOM?
options: No wrapper DOM element; it groups the siblings
A div around both children in every rendering case
A hidden section element with an automatically generated class name
A separate document root that React manages for each child
questions.explanation: A Fragment groups children without producing an extra DOM wrapper.
questions.explanationAr: الـ Fragment بتجمع الأبناء من غير wrapper زيادة في DOM.

questions.question: Why is this not one valid component return expression?
options: React components cannot contain paragraph elements or other text-bearing elements as returned children
A return expression can have only one top-level value; siblings need a wrapper
JSX forbids returning text content from any function component, even inside a heading element
The second element must be mounted separately using createRoot rather than returned by this component
questions.explanation: Adjacent JSX siblings need a single enclosing element or Fragment.
questions.explanationAr: عناصر JSX اللي جنب بعض محتاجة عنصر واحد جامع أو Fragment.

questions.question: What do the braces around label do in these positions?
options: They turn label into the text 'label' literally without reading its variable value
They create a new state variable named label for the button element
They evaluate the JavaScript variable for the prop and child
They make aria-label a boolean prop even though label is a string
questions.explanation: Braces embed the variable's value in both the prop and child content.
questions.explanationAr: الأقواس بتحط قيمة المتغير في الـ prop وفي المحتوى.

questions.question: How is the comment represented inside JSX?
options: As a child element that assistive technology can announce to users
As an HTML comment written without any JSX expression braces
As plain text content displayed between the surrounding div tags
As a JavaScript comment inside a braced expression
questions.explanation: JSX comments use a JavaScript comment inside an expression container.
questions.explanationAr: تعليق JSX بيكون تعليق JavaScript جوه أقواس expression.

questions.question: What is the disabled prop value for this element?
options: false, because the braced expression evaluates to false
true, because writing the prop name always enables it
The string 'false', because JSX converts booleans to text
undefined, because boolean props cannot use braces
questions.explanation: The expression in braces evaluates to the boolean false.
questions.explanationAr: التعبير بين الأقواس بيتقيّم للقيمة المنطقية false.

questions.question: What text does this element render?
options: Hello, name
Hello, Ava
Hello, {name}
Ava, Hello
questions.explanation: The expression inserts the value of name after the literal text.
questions.explanationAr: التعبير بيحط قيمة name بعد النص المكتوب.

questions.question: What text appears inside output?
options: value
undefined
questions.explanation: JavaScript evaluates 2 + 3 before its result is inserted into JSX.
questions.explanationAr: JavaScript بتحسب 2 + 3 قبل ما النتيجة تتحط في JSX.

questions.question: How many wrapper elements does the Fragment add to the DOM?
questions.explanation: Fragments do not create an additional DOM wrapper.
questions.explanationAr: الـ Fragment مابتضيفش wrapper للـ DOM.

questions.prompt: Create a heading element with JSX.
questions.explanation: JSX element syntax begins with an opening angle bracket.
questions.explanationAr: صياغة عنصر JSX بتبدأ بعلامة أصغر من.

questions.prompt: Render the value of total inside this paragraph.
questions.explanation: A JavaScript expression inside braces inserts its value.
questions.explanationAr: تعبير JavaScript بين الأقواس بيحط قيمته.

questions.prompt: Set the CSS class with the JSX class prop.
questions.explanation: JSX uses className to set the rendered class attribute.
questions.explanationAr: JSX بتستخدم className لتحديد class العنصر.

questions.prompt: Close this image element correctly in JSX.
questions.explanation: An element without children must be self-closed in JSX.
questions.explanationAr: العنصر من غير أبناء لازم يتقفل ذاتيًا في JSX.

questions.prompt: Group these siblings without adding a DOM wrapper.
questions.explanation: The short Fragment syntax begins with an empty tag pair.
questions.explanationAr: صياغة Fragment المختصرة بتبدأ بوسم فاضي.

questions.prompt: Write a comment inside the JSX child expression.
questions.explanation: A JSX comment uses JavaScript block-comment syntax inside braces.
questions.explanationAr: تعليق JSX بيستخدم تعليق JavaScript بين أقواس.

questions.prompt: Pass the boolean expression as the disabled prop value.
questions.explanation: Braces allow a JavaScript boolean value to be passed as a prop.
questions.explanationAr: الأقواس بتسمح بتمرير قيمة boolean كـ prop.

questions.prompt: Use the React Fragment component to wrap sibling elements.
questions.explanation: React.Fragment groups siblings without an extra DOM node.
questions.explanationAr: React.Fragment بتجمع العناصر من غير عقدة DOM زيادة.

questions.question: What is JSX, and how should developers think about it?
keyPoints: A syntax extension describing UI elements
Expressions can be embedded in braces
A build transform handles JSX before browser execution
questions.modelAnswer: JSX is a syntax extension commonly used to describe React elements in JavaScript. Braced expressions embed JavaScript values, while JSX attributes follow JSX naming rules such as className. A compiler transform converts the syntax into JavaScript that creates React elements.
questions.explanation: JSX is authoring syntax, not HTML parsed directly by the browser.
questions.explanationAr: JSX صياغة كتابة بتتحول لكود JavaScript، مش HTML المتصفح بيقرأه مباشرة.

questions.question: Why must adjacent JSX elements be wrapped in one parent or Fragment?
keyPoints: A component returns one JSX expression
A Fragment groups siblings without a DOM wrapper
A real element wrapper changes the DOM structure
questions.modelAnswer: A component return statement needs one expression, so adjacent JSX siblings must be grouped. A Fragment provides that grouping without adding a DOM node. A real wrapper is also valid when it has a semantic or layout purpose.
questions.explanation: The grouping requirement concerns the expression shape, while the wrapper choice affects the DOM.
questions.explanationAr: التجميع مطلوب لصيغة التعبير، واختيار wrapper حقيقي بيأثر على DOM.

questions.question: What belongs inside JSX braces?
keyPoints: JavaScript expressions that evaluate to values
Variables and computed values can be embedded
Statements such as if blocks are not directly embedded as expressions
questions.modelAnswer: Braces introduce a JavaScript expression, such as a variable, function call, or arithmetic result. The evaluated value is placed into the JSX tree. A statement like a standalone if block is not itself an expression, so conditional expressions or surrounding logic are used instead.
questions.explanation: Understanding the expression boundary explains which JavaScript forms fit directly in JSX.
questions.explanationAr: فهم حدود expression بيوضح إيه من JavaScript ينفع يتحط مباشرة في JSX.

questions.question: How are comments written inside JSX children?
keyPoints: Use a braced JavaScript expression container
Put a JavaScript comment inside the braces
Do not use bare HTML comment syntax as a JSX child
questions.modelAnswer: Inside JSX children, put a JavaScript comment inside a braced expression container, for example {/* note */}. Bare comment syntax is not an ordinary JSX child. Outside JSX markup, regular JavaScript comment syntax applies.
questions.explanation: The braces switch from JSX child syntax to a JavaScript expression context.
questions.explanationAr: الأقواس بتنقل الصياغة من محتوى JSX لسياق expression في JavaScript.
